notes.title: AnimaEngine 5.0.1
notes.notes:
I solved some issues with the Workshop because some users reported that they couldn't download items. I decided to add a new option in the hidden taskbar menu that allows you to send me your video URL so I can convert it into an Anima animation.
I also added a new option called 'Intelli-Hide Animation'. If you activate it, when you move your mouse over the animation, it will disappear until you leave the area. This is useful if you want to click something behind the animation.
You can find this option in: Main Menu > Animation Menu > Options.

notes.title: ANIMAENGINE 5.0.0
notes.notes: Improved animation engine for new animations that support the g4 format created by us. Don't worry, any animation created with Anima will have that format. We added an option to resize animations with just a button in the animations menu, and three new tools in the creators menu. You will no longer have to restart the application to see your animations downloaded from the workshop.

notes.title: THIS IS NO THE 5.0.0
notes.notes: This is not the 5.0.0 update, it is a jump to test that everything is stable. They have some new functions active, such as easier resizing and that the elements downloaded from the workshop are added automatically without the need to restart. I will be working on stability tests. If I confirm that everything is fine, I will unlock the other improvements, leading to 5.0.0.

notes.title: INTERFACE UPDATE!!!!!!!!!!!!
notes.notes:
First of all, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, dear users. I have resolved the interface issues, and now there are three ways to run AnimaEngine:

AnimaENGINE – Designed for PCs with a low refresh rate, typically older or unofficial versions of Windows 10. 😆
AnimaEngineTK – Optimized for faster refresh rate interfaces, usually for newer Windows 10 and Windows 11.
AnimaEngineKIVI – Combines the best of both worlds, supporting both environments.
As with everything in life, it's best for users to test all three interfaces and choose the one that feels best for them.

Remember, if you have any questions, you can always reach out to us via Discord, email, or social media.

Thank you in advance, and have a great start to your week! 🚀

Anyway, we truly appreciate your patience. Sending you all a big hug, and I hope you enjoy the software!

notes.title: Update 3.0.4
notes.notes:
We solved a problem that caused Windows to detect Gestor.exe as a virus, due to the compiler we used to create that executable, that executable only opens and closes AnimaEngine so you can be sure that it is nothing bad, we attach the Gestor.exe code:

subprocess.Popen("taskkill /im AnimaEngine.exe /F", shell=True)
time.sleep(1)
subprocess.Popen("AnimaEngine.exe")

As you can see, it only opens and closes the app when it needs to be restarted.
